theorem TauCeti.reverseRowBump_eq_some_iff {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] (x y : α) (row result : List α) :
reverseRowBump y row = (result, some x) ↔ ∃ (before : List α), ∃ (after : List α), row = before ++ x :: after ∧ result = before ++ y :: after ∧ (∀ (z : α), z ∈ after → y ≤ z) ∧ x < y

Reverse insertion replaces the rightmost entry x < y, passing a suffix of entries at least y. No ordering hypothesis on the row is needed.
